name: Un Extraño Rescate
summary: Climb one of the towers (some light parkour) and drop in through a roof hatch. Downstairs, a door asks for a code (2341). At the back is an operations room with a recording on a table next to a phone. All the buttons on the board must be blue. Don't take the middle door: there is only radiation behind it. Solving the puzzle frees an alien, who is beamed up to a UFO that then destroys the FIB cars.
